Class_Skill_Desc_Counterstance: Increases parry rate by 100%.</br>Duration: 60s</br>Additional Effect: Grants Fleetfooted to self and nearby party members when executed within proximity of a knowledge crystal</br>Fleetfooted Effect: Increases movement speed</br>Duration: 30m
Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Chakra: Restores 30% of maximum HP and MP.</br>Additional Effect: When HP is less than 30%, restores 70% of maximum HP</br>Additional Effect: When MP is less than 30%, restores 70% of maximum MP
Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Counter: Delivers an attack with a potency of 150 to all enemies in a cone before you.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Can only be executed immediately after parrying an attack.
Class_Skill_Desc_Phantom Kick: Leap towards your target, delivering an attack with a potency of 100 to all enemies in a straight line before you.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Additional Effect: Grants a stack of Phantom Kick up to a maximum of 3, increasing damage dealt by 9%</br>Duration: 40s
Class_Trait_Desc_Enhanced Phantom Kick: Improves Phantom Kick's damage increase to 7%.
Class_Trait_Desc_Enhanced Phantom Kick I: Improves Phantom Kick's damage increase to 9%.
